column1: # models/server-seats.tsv - what the server serves, read by server/scripts/bake-models.sh.
# The server's Ollama must match the desktop's measured setup before any of its
# results can be compared (docs/roadmap.md -> "Next up (2026-10-10): server
# first", step 2). For each seat this file pins:
#   num_ctx   baked into the tag itself, the same value and the same tag name as
#             install-model.sh's <tag>-Nk names, so one run-tasks-models.tsv row
#   num_gpu   only for derived CPU models (0 = no VRAM).
#   from      the base tag a derived model is built from ("-" for a pulled tag).
#   weights   sha256 of the desktop copy's weights blob (/api/show FROM line, read
#             2026-10-10). bake-models.sh compares the server copy against it: a
#             different blob is a different model, so its results are a new era.
#   source    pull (ollama pull the tag), import (the desktop copy is a local GGUF
#             import - copy that GGUF over, or pull and accept new weights),
